name: Signal
summary: Harden the most secure messenger with registration lock, IP protection, and disappearing messages.

settings.name: Registration Lock
settings.impact: Without this, anyone who gains access to your phone number via SIM swap can register Signal on a new device, taking over your account. The PIN prevents this.
settings.source: securityinabox.org: 'Protect yourself when using Signal'; EFF SSD Signal Guide

settings.name: Hide Phone Number
clickPath: Who can see my number: Nobody
Who can find me by number: Nobody
settings.impact: Phone numbers are real-world identity anchors. Hiding your number lets you be contacted via username without exposing it, protecting against doxxing.
settings.source: securityinabox.org; Signal Best Privacy Apps Guide 2025

settings.name: Always Relay Calls
settings.impact: By default, Signal calls are peer-to-peer, revealing your IP address to the person you are calling. Relaying through Signal's servers hides your IP entirely.

settings.name: Screen Security
settings.impact: Without this, Signal messages appear as a preview in the app switcher when switching apps, exposing content to anyone looking over your shoulder.

settings.name: Disappearing Messages Default
settings.impact: Even end-to-end encrypted messages pose a risk if a device is seized or compromised. Disappearing messages ensure content does not remain on either device indefinitely.
settings.source: securityinabox.org; Mozilla Foundation Signal Privacy Review
